basic_details.job_title: IIT Gandhinagar Junior Research Fellow (MSE) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of MSE at the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar has invited applications for one temporary Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in the project "On-chip-based single-photon source with high brightness and spectral purity". The consolidated remuneration is INR 37,000 per month plus 27% HRA (if in-house accommodation is not available), for a 6-month appointment. Candidates need a PG degree in Basic Science or Engineering, or a Graduate/Post Graduate degree in a Professional course, selected through CSIR-UGC NET or GATE or a national level examination. Applications are mad

qualification.details: PG degree in Basic Science or Engineering OR Graduate/Post Graduate degree in Professional course, selected through a process described in either of the following: | Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professor), or GATE. The selection process through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their agencies and institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, etc. | The percentage or grade points will be a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th.

how_to_apply: The notice gives the application link http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/ and asks for applications by 5th December 2026. It does not list documents to attach or describe the form-filling steps. For queries, the notice gives the contact as the PI, Anagh Bhaumik, MSE, with the email [email protected], and asks candidates to mention the PI's name and mail id.
important_instructions: Merely meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee shortlisting and/or appointment. A higher cutoff level may be used. The Institute reserves all rights not to call an applicant for a selection test, or not to fill up a position through this round of selection process, without assigning any reason. The post is a temporary position for 6 months.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice marks "Funding Agency norms" (not "Institute norms") as the eligibility norms for this position. PG degree in Basic Science or Engineering OR Graduate/Post Graduate degree in Professional course, selected through a process described in either of the following: Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professor), or GATE. The selection process through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their agencies and institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, etc. The percentage or grade points will be a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th. Skilled in PVD, CVD, and electrolytic deposition techniques. Skilled in characterization techniques: Raman-PL, XRD, SEM, TEM, XPS, etc. Fundamental knowledge of Quantum Materials and Devices, including III-V materials, Quantum dots, and Quantum wells. Good scientific writing and communication skills. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact wording of the eligibility norms.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly remuneration is INR 37,000/- per month plus 27% HRA, payable if in-house accommodation is not available. The appointment is a temporary position with a duration of 6 months. The notice shows "-" against the separate House Rent Allowance line.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Junior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: Detailed structure-property correlation of InGaAs, CdSe, PbS grown on Si and GaAs wafers. Single-photon purity test. Development of the on-chip single-photon source.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Gandhinagar Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: The notice gives the application link http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/ and asks for applications by 5th December 2026. It does not list documents to attach or describe the form-filling steps. For queries, the notice gives the contact as the PI, Anagh Bhaumik, MSE, with the email [email protected] , and asks candidates to mention the PI's name and mail id.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Merely meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee shortlisting and/or appointment. A higher cutoff level may be used. The Institute reserves all rights not to call an applicant for a selection test, or not to fill up a position through this round of selection process, without assigning any reason. The post is a temporary position for 6 months.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow posts are available at IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: The notice announces one position of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) in the Department of MSE.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar JRF position?
faq.answer: The last date of application submission is 5th December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for the IIT Gandhinagar JRF post?
faq.answer: A PG degree in Basic Science or Engineering, or a Graduate/Post Graduate degree in a Professional course selected through CSIR-UGC NET (including lectureship) or GATE, or a national level examination by Central Government departments, agencies and institutions. Minimum 60% from graduation onwards and 55% in class 10th and 12th.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the IIT Gandhinagar JRF position?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is INR 37,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT Gandhinagar JRF position?
faq.answer: Apply through the application link http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/ before 5th December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is the IIT Gandhinagar JRF job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice calls it a temporary position, with a duration of appointment of 6 months.

faq.question: Q7. Does meeting the minimum eligibility guarantee shortlisting?
faq.answer: No. The notice says a higher cutoff level may be used, and the Institute may decide not to call an applicant for a selection test or not to fill the position through this round.

faq.question: Q8. What will the JRF work on?
faq.answer: The work covers structure-property correlation of InGaAs, CdSe and PbS grown on Si and GaAs wafers, the single-photon purity test, and development of the on-chip single-photon source.
